rules.title: request is deprecated
rules.summary: The package is fully deprecated and no new changes are expected.
rules.replacement: Native fetch or a maintained HTTP client

constraints: Preserve request method, headers, authentication, redirects, timeouts, retries, proxy behavior, streaming, and response/error semantics used by each call site.

steps.title: Choose the target HTTP client
steps.instructions: Select native fetch or one maintained client whose behavior covers the affected request usages.

steps.title: Rewrite request usages
steps.instructions: Translate callbacks, options, response handling, errors, and streams at every reported import and call.

steps.title: Replace the dependency
steps.instructions: Remove request from package metadata and add the selected maintained client only if native fetch is insufficient.

verification.purpose: Run HTTP behavior and repository tests when defined.
Verify imports, types, and the build remain valid.

rules.title: Node Sass is end-of-life
rules.summary: Node Sass is no longer maintained and its repository has been archived.

constraints: Preserve Sass include paths, importer behavior, output style, source maps, and generated CSS expected by the build.

steps.title: Replace Node Sass
steps.instructions: Remove node-sass and add the maintained sass package in the same dependency section.

steps.title: Update compiler usages
steps.instructions: Migrate render and renderSync imports and options to the supported Sass interface used by the project.

steps.title: Compare compiled output
steps.instructions: Review generated CSS and source maps for behaviorally relevant differences.

verification.purpose: Run stylesheet and repository tests when defined.
Compile the project and its stylesheets with Sass.

rules.title: left-pad is deprecated
rules.summary: The package author recommends the built-in String.prototype.padStart method.

constraints: Preserve target width, fill-string behavior, string coercion, and handling of values already wider than the requested length.

steps.title: Replace left-pad calls
steps.instructions: Convert each reported call to String(value).padStart(length, fill) while preserving existing coercion and defaults.

steps.title: Remove the dependency
steps.instructions: Delete left-pad from package metadata and refresh the lockfile.

verification.purpose: Run padding edge cases and repository tests when defined.
Verify the project builds without left-pad.

rules.title: @hapi/joi is deprecated
rules.summary: npm marks @hapi/joi as deprecated and directs users to the joi package.

constraints: Preserve validation schemas, preferences, extensions, and error handling.

steps.title: Replace @hapi/joi
steps.instructions: Move the dependency and imports from @hapi/joi to joi, then adapt any API differences for the installed target version.

steps.title: Verify validation behavior
steps.instructions: Exercise successful and failing validation paths and compare their values and errors.

verification.purpose: Run schema validation and repository tests when defined.

rules.title: babel-preset-es2015 is deprecated
rules.summary: npm recommends babel-preset-env instead of babel-preset-es2015.

constraints: Preserve the JavaScript syntax targets and emitted runtime behavior required by supported environments.

steps.title: Replace the Babel preset
steps.instructions: Replace babel-preset-es2015 with @babel/preset-env and update Babel configuration to use @babel/preset-env.

steps.title: Configure supported targets
steps.instructions: Set explicit target environments so the replacement emits only the transforms and polyfill behavior the project requires.

verification.purpose: Build the project and verify the replacement Babel output.

rules.title: boom is deprecated
rules.summary: npm states that boom moved to @hapi/boom and that the old distribution is no longer maintained.

constraints: Preserve HTTP status codes, payload shape, headers, and error classification.

steps.title: Replace boom
steps.instructions: Move the dependency and imports from boom to @hapi/boom and update changed API calls.

steps.title: Verify HTTP errors
steps.instructions: Compare status codes and serialized error payloads for every affected error path.

verification.purpose: Run HTTP error behavior and repository tests when defined.

rules.title: cryptiles is deprecated
rules.summary: npm states that cryptiles moved to @hapi/cryptiles and that the old distribution is no longer maintained.

constraints: Preserve random-token entropy, timing-safe comparisons, and cryptographic input and output encodings.

steps.title: Replace cryptiles
steps.instructions: Move the dependency and imports from cryptiles to @hapi/cryptiles and adapt changed APIs.

steps.title: Verify cryptographic behavior
steps.instructions: Exercise token generation and comparison paths with their existing encodings and lengths.

verification.purpose: Run security-sensitive behavior and repository tests when defined.

rules.title: gulp-util is deprecated
rules.summary: npm marks gulp-util as deprecated and links to the Gulp migration guidance.
rules.replacement: Maintained purpose-specific modules listed by Gulp

constraints: Preserve each used utility's logging, file, plugin-error, and stream behavior.

steps.title: Inventory gulp-util APIs
steps.instructions: Map every imported gulp-util member to the purpose-specific replacement recommended by Gulp.

steps.title: Install focused replacements
steps.instructions: Replace gulp-util imports and dependency with only the maintained modules required by those usages.

verification.purpose: Run the Gulp build and verify task output.

rules.title: har-validator is deprecated
rules.summary: npm states that har-validator is no longer supported.

constraints: Preserve the accepted HAR specification version, validation strictness, and error reporting.

steps.title: Select a maintained HAR validator
steps.instructions: Choose a maintained validator that supports the project's HAR version and required validation semantics.

steps.title: Replace validation calls
steps.instructions: Translate har-validator calls and handle the replacement's result and error format explicitly.

verification.purpose: Run valid and invalid HAR fixtures and repository tests.

rules.title: inflight is deprecated
rules.summary: npm states that inflight is unsupported, leaks memory, and recommends lru-cache for keyed request coalescing.

constraints: Preserve request coalescing, callback delivery, cache-key identity, and cleanup on success and failure.

steps.title: Replace inflight
steps.instructions: Implement keyed coalescing with lru-cache or another maintained primitive and remove inflight.

steps.title: Verify concurrent behavior
steps.instructions: Test duplicate concurrent requests, failures, retries, and cleanup after completion.

verification.purpose: Run concurrency, memory-lifecycle, and repository tests.

rules.title: istanbul is deprecated
rules.summary: npm states that istanbul is no longer maintained and recommends nyc.

constraints: Preserve test execution, include and exclude patterns, source maps, reporters, and coverage thresholds.

steps.title: Replace Istanbul CLI
steps.instructions: Replace istanbul with nyc in dependencies, scripts, and coverage configuration.

steps.title: Compare coverage output
steps.instructions: Run the same test suite and compare covered files, reporters, and enforced thresholds.

verification.purpose: Run the instrumented test suite and coverage checks.

rules.title: jade is deprecated
rules.summary: npm states that Jade was renamed to Pug and directs users to the pug package.

constraints: Preserve template rendering, locals, includes, inheritance, whitespace, and generated HTML.

steps.title: Replace Jade with Pug
steps.instructions: Replace the jade dependency, imports, file extensions, and build integrations with pug equivalents.

steps.title: Compare rendered output
steps.instructions: Render representative templates and review generated HTML and escaping behavior for differences.

verification.purpose: Run template rendering and repository tests when defined.

rules.title: karma-phantomjs-launcher is deprecated
rules.summary: npm states that PhantomJS development stopped and recommends Puppeteer or a similar maintained browser.
rules.replacement: A maintained Karma browser launcher such as karma-chrome-launcher

constraints: Preserve browser test coverage, Karma execution mode, launch flags, and CI behavior.

steps.title: Select a maintained browser launcher
steps.instructions: Choose a maintained Karma launcher supported by local and CI environments and add its package.

steps.title: Replace PhantomJS configuration
steps.instructions: Replace the PhantomJS launcher and browser name in Karma configuration, then remove karma-phantomjs-launcher.

verification.purpose: Run the browser test suite in its supported local or CI mode.

rules.title: natives is deprecated
rules.summary: npm states that natives relies on Node.js internals and will break, and directs users to graceful-fs 4.x.

constraints: Preserve filesystem behavior, retry semantics, and compatibility with the Node.js versions supported by the project.

steps.title: Replace natives
steps.instructions: Replace the natives dependency and imports with graceful-fs 4.x, using its public filesystem API instead of Node.js internals.

steps.title: Verify filesystem behavior
steps.instructions: Exercise affected file operations, including concurrent access and error paths, on every supported Node.js version.

verification.purpose: Run filesystem behavior and repository tests when defined.

rules.title: node-pre-gyp is deprecated
rules.summary: npm states that the unscoped node-pre-gyp package is deprecated and only @mapbox/node-pre-gyp will receive updates.

constraints: Preserve native-binary download locations, ABI selection, source-build fallback, install scripts, and publishing behavior.

steps.title: Replace node-pre-gyp
steps.instructions: Move the dependency, scripts, imports, and binary configuration from node-pre-gyp to @mapbox/node-pre-gyp.

steps.title: Verify native package installation
steps.instructions: Test prebuilt-binary download and source-build fallback on every supported platform and Node.js ABI.

verification.purpose: Build or install the native package with the scoped replacement.

rules.title: nomnom is deprecated
rules.summary: npm states that nomnom is no longer supported.

constraints: Preserve command names, option aliases, defaults, validation, help output, exit codes, and parsed argument shapes.

steps.title: Select a maintained CLI parser
steps.instructions: Choose a maintained parser that supports the commands and option semantics used by the project.

steps.title: Replace nomnom
steps.instructions: Translate command and option declarations to the selected parser, update imports, and remove nomnom.

verification.purpose: Run CLI parsing, help, error-path, and repository tests.

rules.title: popper.js is deprecated
rules.summary: npm identifies popper.js as the legacy Popper v1 package and directs users to @popperjs/core for Popper v2.

constraints: Preserve placement, modifiers, boundary and overflow behavior, event listeners, and browser support.

steps.title: Replace Popper v1
steps.instructions: Replace popper.js with @popperjs/core and migrate constructors, options, and modifiers to the Popper v2 API.

steps.title: Verify positioned elements
steps.instructions: Exercise every placement, scrolling container, viewport edge, and dynamic update path used by the interface.

verification.purpose: Run positioning and repository tests when defined.

rules.title: Protractor is deprecated
rules.summary: The Protractor maintainers deprecated the package and announced end-of-life for Summer 2023.

constraints: Preserve end-to-end coverage, browser matrix, selectors, waits, authentication state, screenshots, retries, and CI artifacts.

steps.title: Select a maintained end-to-end runner
steps.instructions: Choose a maintained runner that supports the browsers, environments, and test capabilities the suite requires.

steps.title: Migrate the Protractor suite
steps.instructions: Translate configuration, page objects, selectors, waits, assertions, and CI commands incrementally to the selected runner.

verification.purpose: Run the migrated end-to-end suite and repository tests.

rules.title: querystring is deprecated
rules.summary: npm describes the querystring API as legacy and recommends URLSearchParams for new code.

constraints: Preserve percent encoding, repeated keys, empty values, ordering, array handling, and input coercion expected by callers.

steps.title: Replace querystring
steps.instructions: Translate parse and stringify usages to URLSearchParams and remove the querystring dependency.

steps.title: Verify query-string behavior
steps.instructions: Compare representative and malformed inputs, including repeated keys and non-ASCII values, before and after migration.

verification.purpose: Run query parsing, serialization, and repository tests.

rules.title: request-promise is deprecated
rules.summary: npm states that request-promise is deprecated because it extends the deprecated request package.
rules.replacement: Native fetch or a maintained promise-based HTTP client

constraints: Preserve request options, authentication, redirects, timeouts, retries, transforms, full-response mode, and rejection semantics.

steps.title: Select the target HTTP client
steps.instructions: Choose native fetch or one maintained promise-based client that covers the affected request-promise behavior.

steps.title: Replace request-promise
steps.instructions: Rewrite requests, response handling, and errors for the selected client, then remove request-promise.

verification.purpose: Run HTTP behavior and repository tests when defined.

rules.title: request-promise-native is deprecated
rules.summary: npm states that request-promise-native is deprecated because it extends the deprecated request package.
rules.replacement: Native fetch or a maintained promise-based HTTP client

constraints: Preserve request options, authentication, redirects, timeouts, transforms, full-response mode, and native-Promise rejection behavior.

steps.title: Select the target HTTP client
steps.instructions: Choose native fetch or one maintained promise-based client that covers the affected request-promise-native behavior.

steps.title: Replace request-promise-native
steps.instructions: Rewrite requests, response handling, and errors for the selected client, then remove request-promise-native.

verification.purpose: Run HTTP behavior and repository tests when defined.

rules.title: rollup-plugin-babel is deprecated
rules.summary: npm states that rollup-plugin-babel is deprecated and no longer maintained, and recommends @rollup/plugin-babel.

constraints: Preserve Babel presets and plugins, file inclusion, helper strategy, output targets, source maps, and Rollup output behavior.

steps.title: Replace the Rollup Babel plugin
steps.instructions: Replace rollup-plugin-babel with @rollup/plugin-babel and update Rollup imports and plugin options.

steps.title: Verify bundle output
steps.instructions: Compare emitted syntax, helpers, source maps, and bundle behavior for every configured output.

verification.purpose: Build every Rollup output with the maintained Babel plugin.

rules.title: sntp is deprecated
rules.summary: npm states that sntp moved to @hapi/sntp and that the old distribution is no longer supported.

constraints: Preserve server selection, timeout behavior, clock-offset calculations, error handling, and any security-sensitive time checks.

steps.title: Replace sntp
steps.instructions: Move the dependency and imports from sntp to @hapi/sntp and adapt changed APIs.

steps.title: Verify network-time behavior
steps.instructions: Test successful queries, timeouts, invalid responses, and clock-offset handling with controlled fixtures.

verification.purpose: Run time synchronization and repository tests when defined.
